For every canonical Ostrowski word and every depth, the transducer state s_j=(R H_j-b N_j)/b lies strictly between -1 and 1. Therefore literal canonical prefix/inherited-target descent is closed at all depths, including critical, supercritical, and base-reaching depth. The original all-digit target, any redigitized or nonlinear descent, the centered half-bound, proper targets, and every capacity consequence remain open. Booking is zero.
